preconditions.description: The number of jewelry pieces n must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the minimum number of colors k.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()[1:]) == n and all(1 <= int(color) <= k for color in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The second line must contain n space-separated integers representing the colors, each between 1 and k.

postconditions.expression: all((i + 1) % (j + 1) != 0 or colors[i] != colors[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if is_prime(j + 1))
postconditions.description: For any two pieces of jewelry, if the price of one is a prime divisor of the other, they must have different colors.
